note: 演示修改清单：针对 PMC8429493（CC-BY）摘要/引言/实验/结果/结论 5 段摘录的润色，非正式测试案例。

sources.scope: abstract; introduction paragraph 1; experimental excerpt; results excerpt; conclusion

edits.original_span: for the oxygen evolution reaction (OER) remain a great challenge
edits.revised_span: for the oxygen evolution reaction (OER) remains a great challenge
edits.reason: 主语是动名词短语 Developing ... replacements（单数），谓语用 remains

edits.original_span: we report a needle-like cobalt carbonate hydroxide hydrate (Co(CO3)0.5OH.0.11H2O) nanoarrays
edits.revised_span: we report needle-like cobalt carbonate hydroxide hydrate (Co(CO3)0.5OH.0.11H2O) nanoarrays
edits.reason: 不定冠词 a 不能修饰复数 nanoarrays

edits.original_span: nanoarrays, which in situ grown on the surface of carbon cloth
edits.revised_span: nanoarrays, which are grown in situ on the surface of carbon cloth
edits.reason: 定语从句缺谓语：in situ grown 不是谓语形式，补 are grown 并把 in situ 置于动词后

edits.original_span: the Co(CO3)0.5OH nanoarrays with high porosity is composed of numerous
edits.revised_span: the Co(CO3)0.5OH nanoarrays with high porosity are composed of numerous
edits.reason: 主语 nanoarrays 为复数，be 动词用 are

edits.original_span: Owing to unique needle-like array structure
edits.revised_span: Owing to the unique needle-like array structure
edits.reason: 特指该催化剂的阵列结构，需定冠词 the

edits.original_span: For the stability, there is no significant attenuation
edits.revised_span: Regarding the stability, there is no significant attenuation
edits.reason: For the stability 为中式直译，学术英语用 Regarding/As for 引出话题

edits.original_span: after continuous operation 27 h
edits.revised_span: after continuous operation for 27 h
edits.reason: 持续时段前需介词 for

edits.original_span: oxygen evolution reaction (OER) plays an important role
edits.revised_span: the oxygen evolution reaction (OER) plays an important role
edits.reason: 首次全称出现，特指该反应需定冠词 the（与摘要 S1 的 for the oxygen evolution reaction 一致）

edits.original_span: energy-relative electrochemical conversion technologies
edits.revised_span: energy-related electrochemical conversion technologies
edits.reason: energy-relative 是 relative/related 误用的中式英语，正确搭配为 energy-related

edits.original_span: owing to four electron transfer process
edits.revised_span: owing to the four-electron transfer process
edits.reason: 缺冠词；复合形容词 four-electron 需连字符，process 保持单数

edits.original_span: the noble metal-based materials like IrO2 and RuO2 have been regarded
edits.revised_span: noble-metal-based materials such as IrO2 and RuO2 have been regarded
edits.reason: 泛指一类材料不用定冠词；学术文体举例用 such as 而非口语化 like；复合修饰语连字符统一

edits.original_span: the high cost, scarcity reserves and poor stability are main reasons to limit their practical applications
edits.revised_span: their high cost, scarcity and poor stability limit their practical applications
edits.reason: scarcity reserves 为中式叠用（scarcity 已含储量义）；are main reasons to limit 冗余，直接以 limit 作谓语

edits.original_span: in 30 ml deionized water
edits.revised_span: in 30 mL deionized water
edits.reason: 升的符号按 SI 推荐大写 mL（数值 30 不变）

edits.original_span: under vigorous string for 5 min
edits.revised_span: under vigorous stirring for 5 min
edits.reason: string 为 stirring（搅拌）的拼写错误（原文发表版即如此）

edits.original_span: a piece of 2*4 cm2 carbon cloth was immersed into the solution vertically
edits.revised_span: a piece of 2 × 4 cm2 carbon cloth was immersed in the solution vertically
edits.reason: 尺寸相乘用乘号 × 而非星号 *；immerse 搭配介词 in

edits.original_span: After continuous operation 27 h, there is no significant attenuation
edits.revised_span: After continuous operation for 27 h, there is no significant attenuation
edits.reason: 持续时段前需介词 for（与摘要同一问题的另一处）

edits.original_span: the peaks of Co 2p spectrum for Co(CO3)0.5OH@CC negatively shift
edits.revised_span: the peaks of the Co 2p spectrum for Co(CO3)0.5OH@CC shift negatively
edits.reason: 特指谱图需 the Co 2p spectrum；副词 negatively 后置更符合英语语序

edits.original_span: which suggested that Co2+ had a tendency
edits.revised_span: which suggests that Co2+ had a tendency
edits.reason: 主句为现在时（shift），非限定从句时态应一致用 suggests；同 tier（medium）词形变化，强度不变

edits.original_span: had a tendency to transform like Co3+ during the OER process
edits.revised_span: had a tendency to transform into Co3+ during the OER process
edits.reason: transform 表'转化为'搭配 into；like 是介词误用

edits.original_span: suggesting CoOOH may serve as active site for the OER
edits.revised_span: suggesting that CoOOH may serve as the active site for the OER
edits.reason: active site 特指需 the；suggesting 后补 that 使从句完整；may（weak 级限定）逐字保留

edits.original_span: consisting of long-needle like carbonate hydroxide hydrate nanoarrays
edits.revised_span: consisting of long-needle-like carbonate hydroxide hydrate nanoarrays
edits.reason: 复合形容词 long-needle-like 需连字符

edits.original_span: nanoarrays dirrectly in situ growth on carbon cloth substrate
edits.revised_span: nanoarrays grown directly in situ on a carbon cloth substrate
edits.reason: dirrectly→directly 拼写；in situ growth 非谓语，改分词 grown 作后置定语；substrate 前补冠词 a

edits.original_span: by a green and facial one-step hydrothermal strategy
edits.revised_span: by a green and facile one-step hydrothermal method
edits.reason: facial 为 facile（简便的）拼写错误；全文其余两处均为 one-step hydrothermal method，术语统一为 method

edits.original_span: Benefiting from the nanoneedles arrayed architecture and unique active component
edits.revised_span: Benefiting from the nanoneedle-array architecture and unique active component
edits.reason: nanoneedles arrayed architecture 语序中式，复合名词 nanoneedle-array 作定语更自然

edits.original_span: the as-prepared Co(CO3)0.5OH@CC possess abundant accessible active sites
edits.revised_span: the as-prepared Co(CO3)0.5OH@CC possesses abundant accessible active sites
edits.reason: 主语为单数材料名，谓语用 possesses

edits.original_span: robust structure stabilities
edits.revised_span: robust structural stability
edits.reason: stability 为不可数名词，且修饰语应用形容词 structural

edits.original_span: performance towards the OER in alkaline medium (1.0 M KOH)
edits.revised_span: performance towards the OER in an alkaline medium (1.0 M KOH)
edits.reason: medium 可数名词单数前需不定冠词 an

edits.original_span: and could maintained well even after 27 h continuous electrolysis
edits.revised_span: and this performance could be maintained even after 27 h of continuous electrolysis
edits.reason: could maintained 语法错误（情态动词+过去分词）；被维持的是性能，补主语 this performance 并用被动；27 h of 表时长

reviewed_units: Introduction paragraph 1（4 句全读，改 5 处）
Experimental excerpt（5 句全读，改 4 处；S1 与 S5 无问题未改）
Results excerpt（3 句全读，改 5 处）
human_review: Conclusion S1 的 'novel' 属作者的新颖性主张，无证据表明应删除，予以保留；若目标期刊要求克制宣传用语，可删去（待作者确认）
Abstract S6 'paves a facile way to the design' 表达略口语但无语法错误，属作者风格，未改
摘要与引言各自定义了一次 (OER)：摘要独立成篇属期刊惯例，予以保留
uncertainty: 目标期刊未知，排版约定（mL、× 号）按通用 SI/期刊风格处理
演示仅覆盖 5 个摘录段落，未处理全文图表标题与参考文献列表
